name: herdr-live-push
title: Herdr live push: socket event subscription and pane delta streaming
description: Agent subscribes to the herdr socket API (events.subscribe) and pushes pane deltas plus tab/pane/workspace structure changes to the phone immediately, coalescing per pane; the app consumes the push stream and demotes its watchdog to a 10-15s correctness fallback.
creator: lichengyu
